# Path of Flesh
Difficulty: [color=yellow]Varies[/color]
The Path of Flesh revolves around summoning ghouls and monstrosities to do your bidding. Pick this path if you enjoy the fantasy of being a necromancer commanding legions of allies.
## Pros
- Can turn dead humanoids into fragile but loyal ghouls. - Strong mark effect. - Access to a versatile list of summoned minions. - Your summons are very versatile and can quickly overwhelm the crew should you coordinate your attacks - Eating organs and body parts grants various boons (depending on your path stage).
## Cons
- A high degree of your progression is obtaining additional summoned monsters. - You have very little utility beyond your summoned monsters. - You gain no inherent access to defensive, offensive or mobility spells. - You are mostly focused around supporting your minions.
## Knowledge
### Principle of Hunger
Ingredients/Type: Knife, Blood
Creates a bloody blade.
### Grasp of Flesh
Ingredients/Type: Passive Ability
Your grasp can raise the dead as loyal ghouls.
### Mark of Flesh
Ingredients/Type: Passive Ability
Your grasp will now apply the flesh mark, creating flesh mimic of the victim that attack them when triggered.
### Imperfect Ritual
Ingredients/Type: Corpse, Muzzle
Raises the corpse as a Voiceless Dead, a strong, but silent minion.
### Knitting of Flesh
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Grants a spell that works as all surgical tools, heals minions, and provides health analysis and hud.
### Raw Ritual
Ingredients/Type: Eyes, Stomach, Blood
Summons a raw prophet, an entity that can link your summons minds via the mansus link. It is also a strong scout and heals heretics and monsters around it.
### Bleeding Steel
Ingredients/Type: Passive Ability
Your bloody blades now cause heavy bleeding on attack.
### Lonely Ritual
Ingredients/Type: Heart, Stomach, Lung, Pen
Summons a flesh stalker, a strong combat summon with shapeshift and cleave.
### Priest's Final Hymn
Ingredients/Type: Four corpses
You can now shapeshift into extremely powerful creature. Ghoul limit increased. Knit Flesh can now be used in hand to heal ghouls in area.
## Armor and Passive Ability
### T1 Passive
You heal from eating raw meat and organs, as well as become immune to diseases and damage from poisons.
### Writhing Embrace
Chance to split into loyal flesh mimic upon taking damage.
### T2 Passive
Ghoul limit increased.
### T3 Passive
Medical hud.
## Tips
- Your Mansus Grasp allows you to turn dead humanoids into ghouls (even mindshielded humanoids like security officers and the captain). It also Leaves a mark that spawns a loyal flesh mimic when triggered by your bloody blade. - As a Flesh Heretic, organs and dead bodies are your best friends! You can use them for rituals, to heal or to gain buffs. - You can recall your ghouls or summonned creatures by [color=yellow]Alt-Clicking[/color] the ritual rune using your mansus grasp. - Your Flesh Surgery spell can heal your summons. It also acts like a good surgery tool that bypasses surgery steps and works through clothes. - Raw Prophets can link you and other summons in a telepathic network, allowing for long distance co-ordination. They also have healing aura for you and your minions. - Flesh Stalkers are decent combatants with the ability to disguise themselves as various creatures. They can also utilize the Crimson Cleave spell. - Your success with this path is reliant on how knowledgable or robust your minions are. However, there is always power in numbers; the more minions, the higher your chances of success. - Your minions are more expendable than you are. Do not be afraid to tell them to go to their deaths. You can just recover them later... maybe.
